saints.name: Juvenaly of Alaska
saints.dates: Modern period; exact chronology not established here

summary.text: Juvenaly, rendered Juvenal by the cited page, is commemorated as an early missionary martyr in Alaska. The life describes his earlier work, monastic vocation, and journey with the Russian mission. It quotes Herman's testimony and addresses later accounts of his death. This profile identifies the published narrative without treating every subsequently reported episode as independently verified contemporary evidence.

blocks.text: Juvenaly, formerly John Hovorukhin, was a widowed mining engineer who became a monk and joined the Alaskan mission of 1794.

blocks.text: Herman’s letters preserve missionary planning with Macarius and baptismal journeys around Kodiak and the mainland. They traveled in skin boats through difficult weather.
